entries.title: Git status
entries.text: Opens Git status: every PR, branch and VPS worktree sorted into what needs pushing, pulling, CI, merging, what is held and why, what merged today, what runs where and what is stale.

entries.title: Show in Git status
entries.text: Opens Git status at this PR, branch or build, on the tab that holds it, with its row open.

entries.title: Section tabs
entries.text: Each tab is one grid. Needs push: local commits not on GitHub, uncommitted files, pushed branches with no PR. Needs pull: behind main. In CI: running, queued or failed checks. Ready to merge: green and not held. Held: why it can't merge and what clears it. Merged today, Deployed, Stale, Batches.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Reads GitHub and the VPS checkouts again. The page also updates by itself every 20 seconds while it is open.

entries.title: Merge
entries.text: Merges this PR through the push banner: only when it is up to date with main, CI passed on its newest commit and nothing holds it.

entries.title: Hold
entries.text: Keeps this PR from merging (auto-merge skips it, Merge refuses it) until you tap it again.

entries.title: Update from main
entries.text: Pulls main into this PR or branch so it is up to date and CI runs again.

entries.title: Re-run CI
entries.text: Runs the failed CI jobs on this PR's newest commit again.

entries.title: Fix
entries.text: Sends the PR and its failing lines to Merge Max (ops-fix job), who fixes it on its own branch. Uses that agent's budget.

entries.title: Land
entries.text: Sends a stale branch to Landin' Lenny to bring it up to date with main and land it.

entries.title: Close
entries.text: Closes this PR without merging it. Its branch stays.

entries.title: Kill
entries.text: Deletes a stale branch on GitHub that has no open PR.

entries.title: New batch from ready
entries.text: Makes a push batch of every ready PR that isn't in a batch yet.

entries.title: Merge next
entries.text: Merges the first ready PR in this batch's order (pulling main in first when it is behind), or says what the first one waits for.
